# Claude Code files generated by OpenSpec CLI 1.17.0

The `/opsx` commands and skills `openspec update` wrote for Claude Code with CLI 1.17.0. They are preserved from this
repository as it was before it moved to the CLI 2.x layout. The Marketplace screenshot tour copies them into its demo
project, a 1.x-era project, so Explore and Revise Change hand off a real `/opsx:` command.
